verdict.rationale: The evidence has no first-party GitLab integration for viewing or managing external tracker items, such as Jira issues, inside the GitLab UI. The only route is the third-party Unito sync listed in GitLab's partner directory, which connects GitLab with Jira, Trello, GitHub and others and so implies external items could be mirrored into GitLab. Missing for 10: native first-party external issue tracker integration, docs on viewing or editing external issues in the GitLab UI, two-way sync details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
